name: @funcd-dev/example-secret-writer
description: A funcd example of Secret writes: token-owner, the owner of the Secret demo-token, writes and deletes its key TOKEN through context.secret; token-user binds the same Secret and writes it only once a RolesAssignment gives it the role Secret Data Writer. vite build bundles token-owner.mjs and token-user.mjs; each function's I/O contract lives in its <name>.contract.yaml.
